@graph.name: How to Hire a Senior Software Developer
@graph.description: A step-by-step guide to hiring a senior software developer for your web app, AI system, SaaS platform, or backend API project.

step.name: Define your project scope and technical requirements
step.text: Specify: full-stack vs backend-only vs AI specialist, expected tech stack (React/FastAPI/Node.js), engagement model (hourly/retainer/fixed-price), timeline, and compliance requirements (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2).

step.name: Evaluate portfolio and GitHub evidence
step.text: Check: consistent commit history, TypeScript/Python type annotations, test files in repositories, live application performance (Lighthouse, API response times), and specific technical answers in case studies.

step.name: Run a technical interview with high-signal questions
step.text: Ask: 'How would you design a multi-tenant SaaS data model?' / 'How do you handle webhook idempotency?' / 'Walk me through debugging an intermittent production timeout.' Vague answers indicate mid-level experience.

step.name: Choose the right engagement model
step.text: Hourly for exploratory work, retainer for ongoing product development, fixed-price for defined MVPs with written acceptance criteria. Start with a small paid trial task ($200–$500) before committing to a large engagement.

step.name: Agree on milestones, communication, and deliverables
step.text: Define: weekly written updates, Loom demos, GitHub PR review process, staging environment access, milestone acceptance criteria, and handover deliverables (source code, docs, test suite, 60-day warranty).

step.name: Handover and post-launch support
step.text: Final deliverables: source code to your GitHub, API documentation, architecture diagram, test coverage report, Docker deployment config, 60-minute walkthrough, and 60-day bug warranty. Agree on retainer for ongoing development.

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to hire a software developer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ramesh Das: $29/hr hourly, $1,999/mo retainer, from $4,999 fixed-price project, $699 code audit. Significantly below US/EU market rates ($80–$200/hr) for equivalent senior full-stack + AI expertise.

mainEntity.name: How do I choose between hiring a full-stack developer vs a specialist?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hire full-stack for startups/SMEs building MVPs under $150K where one person owns frontend + backend + DevOps. Hire specialists for large teams with parallel workstreams or deep domain needs (ML training, blockchain, native mobile). A senior full-stack developer with AI experience covers 80% of startup software needs.

mainEntity.name: How do I evaluate AI and LLM claims in a software developer's portfolio?

acceptedAnswer.text: Green flags: RAG pipeline with pgvector/Pinecone, RAGAS evaluation metrics, LangChain/LangGraph in GitHub repos, streaming SSE, production AI SaaS with real usage. Red flags: 'AI chatbot' with no RAG/vector DB mention, no prompt engineering discipline, no LLM cost management.

mainEntity.name: Should I hire a freelance software developer or a software development agency?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hire a senior freelancer for projects $5K–$150K needing direct communication and developer continuity. Hire an agency for 3+ concurrent workstreams or enterprise SLA contracts. For most startups and SMEs: a senior freelancer delivers better value.

mainEntity.name: What deliverables should I expect from a senior software developer at project handover?

acceptedAnswer.text: Source code on your GitHub, README, .env.example, OpenAPI docs, database schema docs, test suite with coverage report, Docker Compose, CI/CD pipeline, architecture diagram, 60-minute walkthrough, and 60-day bug warranty.
